newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Banco Frances to pay $401 mln for Credito.
newsitem.headline: Banco Frances to pay $401 mln for Credito.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Frances said Thursday the final price it would pay for a 71.75 percent stake in Banco Credito Argentino had been set at $401.82 million.

Banco Frances made the announcement in a letter to the Buenos Aires stock exchange, but gave no explanation for the difference between this price and the original price of $466 million provided when the deal was first announced in May.

"We wish to inform that the final price for 71.75 percent of the equity of Banco Credito Argentino has been established at $401.82 million," said the announcement from Frances, which is controlled by Spain's Banco de Bilbao Vizcaya.
Banco Frances officials were not immediately available for comment on the apparent price difference.

When the deal was announced in mid-May, Banco Frances said it would be appointing accountants to audit Credito's balance sheet as of end-March this year "and based on that review the price may be reduced."
